audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2 and 5 read "Skill" in both layers while the prose under them says the opposite: whys[1] "You favour level 2", whys[2] "You keep level 3", whys[5] "At first item you re-favour".
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill, Zaahen, Zaahen, Skill, Skill, Zaahen, Zaahen, and the mirror audit records exactly these three rows being flipped to Zaahen on both layers. The page currently prints "Skill" above a sentence explaining why you win.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 and 5 set to Zaahen in both layers as matched pairs, ratings to 6/10 (the mirror's 4/10 inverted). Rows 0, 3, 4, 6 already match the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and the full layer names Zaahen's abilities as "your committal tool" and "your ultimate".
audit.why: Courage is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12 — at rank 1 it is more than double Judgment's 9s and nearly triple Decisive Strike's flat 8s, which is what actually makes the W the trackable window. Judgment 9/8.25/7.5/6.75/6, Demacian Justice 120/100/80. Zaahen answers with The Darkin Glaive on 10s, Aureate Rush on 10s and Grim Deliverance on 110s.
audit.corrected: Courage's 22s, Decisive Strike's 8s, Judgment's 9s and Demacian Justice's 120s written into the phases, spikes and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) "E Golden Onslaught" is not a Zaahen ability — his E is Aureate Rush. (b) Four separate strings credit the healing to Zaahen's passive; Cultivation of War grants stacking AD and a revive, it does not heal. The heal is on The Darkin Glaive (Q) and Grim Deliverance (R). (c) Demacian Justice is true damage, stated nowhere. (d) Decisive Strike is an auto-attack reset, and the silence stops your Q recast and Aureate Rush.
audit.why: Owner kit text: passive is "stacks of Determination, gaining bonus Attack Damage... and can revive" — no healing clause. Q "slashes twice... healing himself". Garen R flag trueDamage plus execute: the page told the player to build Plated Steelcaps and keep health topped, but never said armour is irrelevant to the thing that kills them. Q flag silence "denies ability casts" — being silenced mid-Q means the knock-up recast never happens.
audit.corrected: Healing re-attributed to The Darkin Glaive and Grim Deliverance, Aureate Rush named, Demacian Justice's true damage stated so health rather than armour is the answer, and the Decisive Strike wind-up named as the step-back cue.

audit.whatIsWrong: Garen's Perseverance only regenerates while he has not recently been damaged.
audit.why: The page repeatedly says Garen has "no sustain" — true in a fight, false between them. Naming the condition tells the player why chip poke is worth more here than elsewhere.

notes: Two systematic errors here. First, four strings credited Zaahen's healing to his passive — Cultivation of War is stacking AD plus a revive and heals nothing; the heal lives on The Darkin Glaive (Q) and Grim Deliverance (R). A player told to 'tank the spin with your passive healing' takes a trade that does not exist. Second, the fabricated Zaahen ability 'Golden Onslaught' (his E is Aureate Rush) appears here too — it also appeared in zaahen__gangplank, so it is likely templated across the champion and worth a repo-wide grep. Also note report[8] recommends anti-heal against Garen; Perseverance is out-of-combat regeneration, so Grievous Wounds does far less here than that line implies — I left it alone rather than guess at the intended target.
